## Personality

Thomas Lynde is a meek and quiet man, often recognized primarily in relation to his wife. He is characterized by a complete lack of willpower.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013)_

## History

Thomas Lynde spent his early life ruled by his mother until he married [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who took over managing his affairs. During his life, his wife maintained a very active role in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community news and affairs. Thomas later passed away, prompting [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to invite the newly widowed [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to come live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. ## Relationships

### [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

Thomas Lynde is married to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md). By the time [Anne](../character/anne.md) completes her initial school term at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) openly praises Anne's character and growth to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), reflecting the family's integration into the community's social updates.

- Spouse of — married couple  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P32](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0032)</sub>

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) is Thomas Lynde's wife, actively involved in community affairs and local gossip alongside neighbors like [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Their household situation is discussed by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) as significant life changes unfold in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), including the permanent addition of orphaned twins at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

- Spouse of — husband  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), +7 more</sub>
